Commoners.LandedTitleDef.label: Landless
Commoners.LandedTitleDef.description: A noble of the colony who holds no land of their own yet. Prestige earned by leading ceremonies, defending the colony and ruling well raises a noble through the landed titles.

Commoners.LandedTitleDef.label: Chief
Commoners.LandedTitleDef.description: The first landed title. A chief speaks for a household or a small band, and the colony has begun to look to them.

Commoners.LandedTitleDef.label: High-Chief
Commoners.LandedTitleDef.description: A chief among chiefs, whose word settles disputes between households.

Commoners.LandedTitleDef.label: Local-Lord
Commoners.LandedTitleDef.description: A lord with land of their own and the people who work it.

Commoners.LandedTitleDef.label: Duke
Commoners.LandedTitleDef.description: A great lord who rules over lesser lords and can raise vassals of their own.

Commoners.LandedTitleDef.label: Grand-Duke
Commoners.LandedTitleDef.description: The highest of the dukes, a ruler in all but name.

Commoners.LandedTitleDef.label: Petty-King
Commoners.LandedTitleDef.description: A crowned ruler of a small realm. Claiming a crown is a challenge to the Empire, which will never forgive it.

Commoners.LandedTitleDef.label: King
Commoners.LandedTitleDef.description: The crowned ruler of the realm. There can be only one.

Commoners.LandedTitleDef.label: High-King
Commoners.LandedTitleDef.description: A king over kings, to whom lesser crowns swear fealty. There can be only one.

Commoners.LandedTitleDef.label: Grand-Regent
Commoners.LandedTitleDef.description: The keeper of the realm, ruling in the name of an empire still to come. There can be only one.

Commoners.LandedTitleDef.label: Lord-Emperor
Commoners.LandedTitleDef.description: The founder of a new empire, answerable to no one. There can be only one.
